How Reverse GST Works in New Zealand

Quick Answer: To take 15% GST out of a GST-inclusive price, multiply it by 3 and divide by 23. That gives the GST. Subtract the GST from the total to get the price before GST. For $200, GST is $26.09 and the price before GST is $173.91.

Why 3/23?

GST is 15% of the price before GST, so the inclusive total is 115% of that net price. GST is therefore 15 out of every 115 parts, which simplifies down to 3/23 (since 15 ÷ 5 = 3, and 115 ÷ 5 = 23). Dividing by 1.15 produces the same mathematical answer, but the fraction 3/23 avoids compounding rounding discrepancies across multi-line invoices.

Three Ways to the Same GST Amount

Multiplying by 3 and dividing by 23, dividing by 1.15 and subtracting, and dividing by 7.6666667 are three different ways of writing the exact same mathematical formula. When computed in full precision, they all agree to the exact cent.

Method Working for $200 GST Result
× 3 ÷ 23 (Official IRD Formula) 200 × 3 ÷ 23 $26.09
÷ 1.15, then subtract 200 − (200 ÷ 1.15) $26.09
÷ 7.6666667 200 ÷ 7.6666667 $26.09

Adding GST instead

If you have an exclusive amount and want to add tax, simply multiply the price before GST by 0.15 and add it on. You can use the "Add GST" button at the top of this calculator or explore our full GST Calculator NZ.

Frequently Asked Questions About Reverse GST in NZ

How do you remove GST from a price in NZ?

Multiply the GST-inclusive price by 3, divide by 23, and subtract that GST result from the total. For example, on a $230 invoice, multiply by 3 ($690) and divide by 23, giving $30 GST and a net price of $200.

What about zero-rated and exempt supplies?

Zero-rated supplies (such as many exported goods and international services) are taxed at 0%. Exempt supplies (such as residential rental rent and financial services) sit completely outside the GST system. Neither should be split using the 3/23 fraction.

When must a business register for GST in New Zealand?

GST registration with Inland Revenue (IRD) is legally required when your gross business turnover reaches, or is projected to reach, NZ$60,000 across any rolling 12-month period. You may also register voluntarily below this threshold.

How is penny rounding handled on invoices?

GST is mathematically rounded to the nearest cent ($0.01). The price before GST is calculated by subtracting that exact rounded GST amount from the inclusive total, ensuring the two figures always reconcile perfectly to your invoice total.
